KWDB Data Migration Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces automated heterogeneous database migration to KaiwuDB / KWDB using the KDTS REST API.
- Guides users step-by-step to collect required migration parameters and manages the full migration workflow.
- Supports migrations from popular databases (MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, ClickHouse, TDengine, InfluxDB, OpenTSDB, MongoDB, FTP, HDFS) to KaiwuDB.
- Handles migration tasks including connection testing, schema sync, DDL generation, data transfer, and progress tracking.
- Includes clear configuration options and user prompts for KDTS server setup.
- Responds in Chinese or English depending on user language for a friendly, guided experience.
